thread:
incident-bot: Pager alert: spike in 5xx/timeouts for POST /v1/chat.stream in eu-central-1. p95 jumped from 180ms -> 3.8s, p99 ~ 8.7s. Error mix: 502/504 + downstream rpc timeouts. Severity: Sev2.
jen: I'm on it, looking at traces/dashboards. triggering runbook A for timeout waves.
rafael: joining. Any fresh deploys to eu region in last 20m?
sofia: we promoted 2026-03-15-mux-tune to canary at 08:12 UTC (~10m ago) for multiplexing improvements.
infra-oncall: taking pager. Traces show long queuing on proxy thread pool and stalled http2 streams. Worker pods show normal CPU/GPU. Connection pool saturation between proxy <-> worker.
jen: logs show repeated: "upstream read timeout: context deadline exceeded" and "http2: stream closed". snippet: ```WARN proxy: stream closed before response: streamID=0x4b2c```
rafael: tcpdump from a proxy host shows many FIN/RECV_RST between proxy and worker nodes; connection reuse looks poor. Also observe increased accept() backlog on worker side.
deploy-bot: canary deployment 2026-03-15-mux-tune rolled to 10% at 08:12:05 UTC.
sofia: recent change reduced http2 max_concurrent_streams and tweaked max_inflight_per_worker. Might be too conservative.
infra-oncall: recommend immediate rollback of canary to stop further customer impact. Also propose enabling short-circuit fail-fast for streaming requests >2.5s to drain queues.
jen: initiating rollback now. deploy-bot: revert 2026-03-15-mux-tune -> 2026-03-07-stable initiated by jen at 08:18:22 UTC.
incident-bot: Rollback in progress. Redirecting canary traffic back to stable. Notifying infra and SRE channels.
ops-bot: autoscale: added 3 proxy instances to absorb backlog at 08:19:10 UTC per oncall request.
rafael: grabbing heap profiles and http2 metrics dump from proxy hosts. saving to /var/tmp/incidents/7234567890/.
sofia: enabling circuit-breaker: threshold=2500ms, max_waiters=100, fail_fast=true for /v1/chat.stream. Also temporarily disabling model fallback to avoid model-layer load.
infra-oncall: post-rollback telemetry: p95 dropped to 240ms within 3m, p99 trending toward 1.1s. error ratio dropped from 10.5% -> 0.9%.
jen: customer impact estimate: ~1.2% of active API keys experienced increased errors between 08:12-08:20 UTC; top affected routes are streaming chat and long-run completions. Suggest brief status page update: "Intermittent timeouts during deploy in EU; mitigated by rollback. No data loss."
rafael: trace ids archived for RCA: [r-e9f1, r-e9f2, r-e9f4]. network captures and thread dumps uploaded.
sofia: root cause hypothesis: overly aggressive reduction of max_concurrent_streams + lower max_inflight caused head-of-line backpressure and connection churn; combined with shorter keepalive and http2 churn, proxy pools hit accept backlog and started timing out streams.
infra-oncall: follow-up actions: revert mux parameter change in config repo, add canary gating that blocks promotion if p95 > 1s for 3 consecutive minutes, add synthetic streaming smoke that simulates long-lived streams during canary ramp.
ops-bot: queue: created follow-up ticket INC-2026-0456 "http2 multiplexing tuning caused proxy queueing and timeouts" assigned to sofia, jen, rafael.
jen: recommend adding replay test that opens many concurrent http2 streams and validates connection reuse under keepalive variations.
sofia: will also add a preflight check in deploy pipeline to run a 2-min load that asserts max_conn reuse > 80% and p99 < 1s.
pager: closing pager: mitigated and rolling metrics stable. Hand off to owners for postmortem.
jen: postmortem owners: jen (lead), sofia (config/deploy), rafael (traces/net), infra-oncall (mitigation/runbook). Draft due 36h.
rafael: leaving one note: add tests for client side backpressure handling; we saw retries amplifying short bursts.
sofia: schedule a follow-up sync at 1600 UTC to review config changes and add gating.
incident-bot: Incident resolved at 08:21:15 UTC. Duration ~9 minutes.
